5. Gas Distribution System:
The Gas Distribution System for the project area is illustrated in schematic form on Figure 5. Exhibit 7.
The existing gas distribution system in the area consists of a grid network of generally adequate capacity with 4" mains being the predominant size. Certain additions to and modifications of the existing system are proposed to serve the redevelopment area as follows:
a. The relocation of Lakeview Avenue between Lombardy and Harrison necessitates installation of a new 6" main to maintain the distribution grid and provide service to the adjacent redevelopment.
b. The extension of Colorado Avenue from Randolph Street connecting to Harrison Street and redevelopment of adjacent property requires a new 6" main.
C. The closing of Kemper Street from Allen Avenue to Harrison Street requires the extension of a 9" intermediate pressure main to Idlewood Avenue from Allen Avenue to Clark Springs School.
d. The extension of Grayland Avenue from Allen Avenue to Lady Street, Davis Avenue to Shields Avenue, and Harrison Street to Idlewood Avenue, and redevelopment of land adjacent thereto necessitates a new 4" main extension.
e. Street closures and street improvements will necessitate adjustment of existing facilities including abandonment of existing mains and service and adjustment of mains, valves and other appurtenances.
